evidence_rules.primary_endpoint: Final communication round; never select the best seed or round silently
evidence_rules.display_accuracy: Multiply by 100 for percent; accuracy differences are percentage points
evidence_rules.seed_aggregation: Report individual seeds, arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation
evidence_rules.smoke_tests: Single-seed or short runs validate execution, not scientific conclusions
evidence_rules.historical_p3_results: Experiments 01-03 are two-round smoke tests from an older protocol and are not directly comparable
evidence_rules.historical_p2_results: Stale-marked outputs must not be cited as regenerated real-data results
evidence_rules.compression: mean_residual_energy is absolute squared error; mean_tail_mass is relative squared error
evidence_rules.communication: Keep effective-matrix and operational staged accounting separate; preserve payload dtype and representation
evidence_rules.privacy: No privacy guarantee follows from decentralized communication or adapter-only sharing
evidence_rules.oracle: Known domain assignments are inputs, not a successful domain-discovery result
evidence_rules.feasible_baseline: Compare adaptive rank against a capability-matched fixed baseline (ranks within each client's maximum). The fixed rank-32 reference is infeasible for every client and is a compute reference only; label it as such wherever it appears.
evidence_rules.test_machine: gpu003 is the required test and experiment machine. Local tests do not replace SSH validation.
evidence_rules.historical_results: Superseded results are preserved and labeled historical; they are never deleted or silently overwritten.

scientific_conclusion.scope: CIFAR-100; frozen ResNet-18 features and a LoRA classification head; single-process peer-flow simulation
scientific_conclusion.primary_reference: ordinary pooled rank16 LoRA with persistent Adam, same full dataset/test set
statements: The implemented accuracy-preservation methodology is unsuccessful under this fixed30-round protocol. This is not a universal impossibility result.
A large gap already exists in uniform-rank FedAvg and peer baselines; adaptation is not the only source of shortfall.
Domain weighting is active and yields small seed-dependent changes; historical identical results came from erased weights.
Training factor traffic decreases with adaptive ranks, but dense domain-control traffic dominates total payload.
No privacy guarantee has been demonstrated. Data-local simulation and LoRA do not establish protection against update leakage.
The previous p3-e2e-ablation comparison is superseded and excluded from current conclusions.
scientific_conclusion.uncertainty: sample standard deviation across paired seeds (ddof=1), not a confidence interval

completion_statement: The corrected nine-arm, three-seed experiment is complete and validated. Its accuracy-preservation objective is not achieved. This scoped implementation result does not claim production multi-host deployment, neighborhood-local discovery, or privacy protection.

merged_delivery.scope: Completed scoped experiment; accuracy-preservation unsuccessful; no privacy guarantee

latest_study.name: RoBERTa-base/SST-2 quantity-skew decentralized LoRA
latest_study.scope: Seven matched quantity arms and one separate equal-size anchor; single-process peer-transport simulation
latest_study.conclusion: Adaptive/sample saves training traffic relative to rank16, but has lower mean accuracy; rank4 is cheaper and has higher mean accuracy. Superiority, parity, total-memory savings and privacy guarantees are not established.
latest_study.historical_fields_notice: The historical experiment_plan, metric_dictionary and result records elsewhere in this file refer to earlier CIFAR-100/component studies unless their own scope says otherwise.
